verses.1: Thus I saw Adonai Yehovah, and there he was, creating the world at the beginning of its creation. And then there was also the “lakes” among the kings.
verses.2: And if he were to eat the fruit of the earth, then I would say, “Lord Jehovah, please forgive him. Who will rise up like Jacob? He’s too young.”
verses.3: May the LORD be merciful for this; may He not allow it to happen.
verses.4: “Thus I saw the temple of Jehovah; and behold, a great fire was sent forth from it. The temple of Jehovah burned down, and its contents were consumed.”
verses.5: And he said, “O Lord Yahweh, please stop this. Who will rise up like Jacob? He is too young.”
verses.6: May the LORD be merciful to this situation. But still, it will not be possible, O Lord.
verses.7: So I saw, and behold! Adonai stands over your household; in his hand are you.
verses.8: And the LORD said to me, “What do you see? It’s a heavy burden.” I said, “Adonai, I am here with my people, the Israelites. I will not go any further from them.”
verses.9: And they were destroyed in their own deaths. The temples of Israel were ruined. I stood over the house of Jeroboam in destruction.
verses.10: And Amasya sent a messenger to King Jeroboam of Israel, saying, “A great burden has been brought upon you from the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all of its burdens.”
verses.11: For Amos said, “In the year of their destruction, Jerubbaal will die, and Israel will be scattered across the land.”
verses.12: And Amasya said to Amos, “Go and flee into the land of Judah. There, you will eat bread and live on that land.”
verses.13: And in the House of God, there will be no more miracles. For it is the house of the King, and it belongs to the King.
verses.14: And he became depressed and said to Amasya, “I will not be a prophet. I will not have a son who can become a prophet. For I am still young and inexperienced.”
verses.15: And Jehovah took me from behind the sheep, and He said to me, “Go, O Israel!”
verses.16: And now, when you have heard the words of Jehovah, then say that you will not rebel against Israel, and you will not speak evil of the house of Ishmael.
verses.17: Therefore, thus says the LORD: Your women will be raped in the city, and your sons and daughters will be killed. Your land will be divided up among others. You will die on a dirty land. And Israel will be destroyed from its land.
